pourready.title: PourReady // 01
pourready.desc: A field-tested concrete volume estimator built directly for jobsites. Precise calculations for slabs, footings, walls, and columns with custom waste safety margins.

shotstack.title: ShotStack Studio // 02
shotstack.desc: A storyboard compiler allowing video editors, film directors, and design teams to compile images, screenshots, and annotation notes into an exportable PDF layout.

tap.title: TAP: Time & Place // 03
tap.desc: An authenticated, minimal field tracking protocol providing cryptographic proofs of location, activity, and duration directly from active project sites.

ampliloop.title: AmpliLoop Studio // 04
ampliloop.desc: A high-performance algorithmic rap beat generator, precise metronome, and software instrument tuner running locally via fast Blazor WebAssembly compiles.

aac.title: Anytime Animal Control // 05
aac.desc: Live wildlife removal and control service website. Provides field diagnostics, coverage maps, dispatch contacts, and pest management information.

intake.title: Dondlinger Voice Intake // 06
intake.desc: Frictionless voice-first client onboarding. Tap to record your project vision securely via microphone, transmitting directly to the local inbox.

omw.title: On My Way (OMW) // 07
omw.desc: Live GPS and ETA broadcasting tool. Allows field technicians and contractors to securely share live travel status and exact arrival times with project managers and clients.

zla.title: Zero Liability Architecture // 08
zla.desc: A software architecture that runs high-impact business utilities entirely within your browser. Because no data is uploaded to a server, there are no logins and zero risk of data breach.

heckler.title: Heckler Audio Synth // 09
heckler.desc: Blazor WASM audio trigger engine for soundboard diagnostics, tone synthesis, and high-velocity alerts.

timeline.title: TimelineZLA Sync // 10
timeline.desc: A secure, local-first daily log and project timeline builder. Enables teams to construct site timelines and peer-to-peer sync via 6-digit codes with instant PDF export.

skydrop.title: SkyDrop Peer Transfer // 11
skydrop.desc: A secure, zero-liability peer-to-peer file sharing utility. Allows instantaneous direct WebRTC transfers between devices with no cloud storage and zero account login.

touchscreen.title: Touchscreen Diagnostic // 12
touchscreen.desc: An interactive client-side hardware diagnostic PWA. Verify touchscreen hardware responsiveness, paint touch grids to identify dead zones, and monitor ghost touches in real-time.

wazweather.title: WaZ Weather Dashboard // 13
wazweather.desc: Blazor WASM atmospheric telemetry, live radar mapping, river hydrology flow rates, and rain outlook dispatch for Wisconsin Rapids.

personalization.title: Personalization Engine // 14
personalization.desc: Metropolis desktop customizer, dynamic glassmorphism theme generator, and Metropolis taskbar state manager.

theater.title: Neural Cinema & Theater // 15
theater.desc: Streaming neural radio theater, multi-speaker audio dramas, 9:16 vertical cinema, and typeset screenplays engineered by John Dondlinger.
